reviewText: The 7x7 grid logic is super addictive. Finally, a puzzle game that actually makes you think instead of just mindlessly tapping the screen.
Amazing interface, very clean and professional. Runs perfectly on my phone without any heating issues, even after playing for an hour.
Game ka concept toh badiya hai, but the 777 challenge is too difficult for me. Thoda tough hai, par graphics are top notch.
Finally, a logic game that doesn't rely on luck. The 7x7 grid layout is super clean and the routing mechanics feel incredibly polished.
Bohot hi mazedaar game hai! No lag, no heating on my phone, and the synth music is perfect for focusing. Highly recommended for puzzle lovers.
The 777 Protocol is absolutely intense. My brain feels so much sharper after clearing these levels. Flawless touch response.
Very solid puzzle experience. I really enjoy the campaign mode, although the difficulty jumps quite a bit around level 50. Still a great way to kill time during my commute.
The graphics are top-notch and the mechanics are unique, but it gets a bit too stressful for me in the later stages. Good for logic fans, but maybe too hard for casual playing.
